label: History
value: Dorothy falls into the underground realm of the Mangaboos during an earthquake
unit: Toto accompanies Dorothy when their Kansas farmhouse is swept away by a cyclone into the Land of Oz. During their journey to the Emerald City, Toto travels alongside the Scarecrow, Tin Woodman, and Cowardly Lion, eventually exposing the Wonderful Wizard of Oz as a humbug by knocking down the screen concealing him. After returning to Kansas via the Golden Cap and Glinda's magic, Toto later falls into the underground realm of the Mangaboos during an earthquake alongside Dorothy, Zeb, and Jim the Cabbageway Horse. He journeys through Ev and Oz during Ozma's birthday celebration, where he reveals that he can speak in Oz but usually chooses not to because he has nothing important to say.

label: History
value: Johnny Dooit encounters Polychrome
unit: Johnny Dooit encounters Dorothy, the Shaggy Man, Button-Bright, and Polychrome during their travels in the dangerous lands outside Oz in The Road to Oz. Finding the travelers stranded by the Deadly Desert, he offers his assistance using his miraculous tool-bag. In a matter of minutes, he chops down trees and constructs a sturdy sand-boat equipped with sails so they can safely cross the scorching sands. After completing the vessel and ensuring the companions can cross safely, he uses his magic sand-stars to instantly transport himself away to his next adventure.

label: History
value: Tiktok joins Billina on their quest to rescue the royal family of Ev from the Nome King.
unit: Tiktok was created by the firm of Smith and Tinkell in the Land of Ev. He was purchased by King Evoldo, who eventually locked him inside a rock cave near the sea before throwing the key into the ocean. Dorothy Gale discovers Tiktok in the cave during her journey through Ev, winds up his clockwork mechanisms, and frees him. Tiktok joins Dorothy, Billina, and Princess Ozma on their quest to rescue the royal family of Ev from the Nome King. During the confrontation in the Nome King's underground kingdom, Tiktok bravely assists the party before running down during the magic guessing game, but he is eventually rewound and helps secure their victory. Following the defeat of Roquat the Nome King, Tiktok travels to the Land of Oz and settles in the Emerald City, becoming a valued subject of Princess Ozma.

label: History
value: The Wicked Witch of the West ruled the Winkie Country.
unit: The Wicked Witch of the West ruled the Winkie Country in the western quadrant of Oz with an iron fist, enslaving its native yellow people. When the Wizard of Oz sent Dorothy Gale and her companions to destroy her, the Witch observed their approach with her single powerful eye. She sent packs of wolves, flocks of crows, and swarms of black bees to destroy them, but Dorothy's companions defeated each threat. Finally, the Witch used her third and final charm of the Golden Cap to summon the Winged Monkeys, ordering them to destroy the Tin Woodman and Scarecrow, capture the Cowardly Lion, and bring Dorothy to her castle unharmed because of the mark of the Good Witch's kiss. She enslaved Dorothy as a kitchen maid and starved the Lion in an effort to harness him, while scheming to steal Dorothy's Silver Shoes. She tricked Dorothy into tripping over an invisible iron bar, causing one of the Silver Shoes to fall off, which the Witch seized. Enraged by the theft and cruelty, Dorothy threw a bucket of water over the Witch, unaware that water was fatal to her. The Wicked Witch melted away completely, freeing the Winkies and ending her evil reign.

label: Appearance
value: Each of Princess Langwidere's heads has its own unique expression.
unit: Princess Langwidere possesses thirty distinct, interchangeable heads, each with its own hair color, facial features, and unique expression. She keeps twenty-nine of these heads locked in velvet-lined cabinets within her boudoir, wearing one at a time to suit her mood. Her dresses and robes are styled to match whichever head she is currently wearing. Regardless of which head she wears, she is slender and elegant in bearing.

label: Appearance
value: His lifestyle is underground.
unit: He is a bent old man whose hair and long beard are meticulously woven into hundreds of tight braids. Each braid is tied at the end with a colorful ribbon. He wears simple clothes suited for his underground lifestyle among the rocks.

label: History
value: The Hungry Tiger travels to the Kingdom of Ev
unit: The Hungry Tiger is introduced in Ozma of Oz as a close friend and companion of the Cowardly Lion. He travels to the Kingdom of Ev to aid Dorothy Gale and Princess Ozma in rescuing the Royal Family of Ev from the Nome King. Along with the Cowardly Lion, he pulls Princess Ozma's red chariot and guards her throne room. During the expedition into the Nome King's underground realm, he stands loyally by Ozma and helps carry the party back safely. In The Road to Oz, he participates in the celebrations held in the Emerald City for Princess Ozma's birthday, remaining one of her primary animal guards and sworn protectors.

label: Background by volume
value: Was enlarged to human size by Professor Nowitall using a magic lantern projector.

label: Appearance
value: Ozma's hair is adorned with flowers.
unit: Ozma is a beautiful young princess with dark hair adorned with flowers or a royal crown. She is typically dressed in elegant royal gowns and carries a serene, regal demeanor despite her youth. Her gentle expression and grace command respect from all the inhabitants of Oz.

label: Personality
value: Roquat prefers to trick his visitors into inescapable traps rather than engage in fair combat.
unit: Roquat is extremely greedy, hot-tempered, and cruel, valuing his vast collection of underground treasures above all else. He is deceitful and cunning, preferring to trick his visitors into inescapable traps rather than engage in fair combat. Despite his grand pretensions, he harbors a deep terror of eggs, which are fatal to Nomes. He holds immense grudges and reacts violently whenever his authority or possessions are challenged.

label: Traits
value: Proud

label: Personality
value: The Wizard initially admits to being a humbug.
unit: The Wizard is a kindly, gentle, and resourceful man who relies on quick wit and clever trickery rather than genuine magic to solve problems. Though he initially admits to being a humbug, he is genuinely good-hearted and cares deeply about the well-being of his friends. He possesses a strong sense of humor, humility, and willingness to learn true magic once he returns to Oz.

label: History
value: Tin Woodman used his axe to protect his companions from various dangers.
unit: Discovered by Dorothy Gale and the Scarecrow in the forest, he was oiled and freed from his rusted state, joining them on their journey to the Emerald City in hopes of receiving a heart from the Wizard of Oz. Along the way, he used his axe to protect his companions from various dangers. After helping defeat the Wicked Witch of the West, the Winkies invited him to become their ruler, a title he accepted after visiting the Wizard, who gave him a velvet heart filled with sawdust. He later helped Dorothy return home and assisted in defeating the Nome King during Ozma's expedition to the Nome Kingdom. He continues to rule the Winkie Country from his palace made of tin, remaining one of Princess Ozma's most trusted companions.

label: Appearance
value: Toto has long, silky hair.
unit: Toto is a small black dog with long, silky hair and small black eyes that sparkle merrily. He wears a collar and is small enough to be carried comfortably by Dorothy in a basket or in her arms.

label: History
value: Jinjur thwarts the Scarecrow
unit: Discontent with the male-dominated rule of the Scarecrow, Jinjur secretly recruits an Army of Revolt composed entirely of young women armed with knitting needles. Exploiting the pacifism of the Emerald City's guard and the city's fear of mice, Jinjur marches on the capital, forces the Scarecrow to surrender, and declares herself Queen of Oz. During her brief reign, she and her soldiers spend their time lounging in the palace, eating caramels, and decorating themselves with emeralds. When Tip, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Woggle-Bug attempt to reclaim the city, Jinjur thwarts them repeatedly using military strategies and magical counter-defenses provided by Mombi. Ultimately, Glinda the Good Arrives with her own army, besieging the city and forcing Jinjur to surrender. Upon learning that Princess Ozma is the rightful ruler, Jinjur willingly steps down, renounces her rebellion, and returns to a quiet life on a farm with her husband.

label: Princess Ozma
value: Enemy of — Ozma led the rescue mission to free the Royal Family of Ev from his grasp.

label: History
value: Dorothy helped Button-Bright reach the Emerald City.
unit: Dorothy Gale's adventures began when a Kansas cyclone transported her house to the magical Land of Oz. Seeking a way home, she traveled the yellow brick road to the Emerald City alongside the Scarecrow, Tin Woodman, and Cowardly Lion, eventually defeating the Wicked Witch of the West and learning how to return to Kansas using the Silver Shoes. Later, while at sea, Dorothy was swept overboard in a storm and landed in the underground realm of Ev, where she rescued the Royal Family of Ev from the Nome King with the aid of Billina the hen and Ozma of Oz, earning her title as a Princess of Oz. Soon after, Dorothy was swallowed by an earthquake in California and descended into the subterranean world of the Mangaboos with her cousin Zeb and Jim the cab-horse; there she reunited with the Wizard of Oz and journeyed through various underground lands before returning to the surface. Most recently, Dorothy set out on a wandering journey in Kansas, lost her way on magical roads, and helped the Shaggy Man, Button-Bright, and Polychrome reach the Emerald City in time to attend Princess Ozma's grand birthday celebration.

label: Personality
value: Jack displays unwavering loyalty to Princess Ozma.
unit: Jack is gentle, good-natured, and exceptionally simple-minded, often taking metaphors literally. He accepts his physical limitations and short lifespan with cheerful innocence. He displays unwavering loyalty to his creator Tip and to Princess Ozma, regarding her with deep affectionate respect. Though easily confused, he remains polite and optimistic in every situation.

value: Fear of confrontation

label: Appearance
value: The ears of the Saw-Horse are carved out of bark.
unit: The Saw-Horse is a wooden horse made from a carpenter's saw-horse with four legs, a log body, and a branch for a tail. His head is formed from a small log with a knot that resembles a snout, and he has ears carved out of bark. His feet are shod with gold to prevent his wooden legs from wearing down as he runs.

label: Appearance
value: Tip wears simple clothing.
unit: Tip is a young, slender boy with a lively expression and fair features. He wears simple, somewhat worn clothing typical of a country boy in the Gillikin region. His energetic demeanor and youthful vitality are evident in his swift movements.

label: Personality
value: The Hungry Tiger possesses a gentle heart.
unit: Despite his enormous size and predatory nature, the Hungry Tiger possesses a tender conscience and a gentle heart. He constantly complains of a desperate desire to eat fat babies, yet his moral compass prevents him from ever harming a living creature. He suffers from immense self-pity over his endless, unfulfilled hunger, preferring to starve rather than commit a cruel act.

label: History
value: Zeb traveled through several dangerous underground kingdoms.
unit: Zeb was sent to pick up Dorothy Gale from the railway station in California to take her to Hugson's Ranch. During their drive, a massive earthquake split the ground open, swallowing Zeb, Dorothy, Jim the horse, and Eureka the kitten into the subterranean worlds beneath the Earth's surface. Together with the Wizard of Oz, whom they met in the realm of the Mangaboos, Zeb traveled through several dangerous underground kingdoms, fighting off invisible Gargoyles and wooden Gargoyles. He defended his companions bravely using a sword during their battles. Eventually, Princess Ozma used the Magic Belt to rescue the group and bring them to the Land of Oz. After enjoying a brief stay in the Emerald City, Zeb and his horse Jim were sent back to California by Ozma's magic.

label: Nicknames
value: The Wizard; Oscar Diggs

label: History
value: Ozma used her Magic Picture to locate Dorothy and her companions.
unit: Ozma was hidden away as an infant by the Wizard of Oz, who gave her to the wicked witch Mombi. Mombi transformed the baby princess into a boy named Tip to conceal her true identity. Growing up as Tip, she eventually ran away from Mombi, creating Jack Pumpkinhead and the Sawhorse along the way, and helped liberate the Emerald City from General Jinjur's Army of Revolt. Glinda the Good discovered Tip's true identity, compelled Mombi to reverse the spell, and restored Princess Ozma to her rightful throne. As ruler, she led an expedition to Ev to rescue the royal family from the Nomad King, successfully retrieving them with the help of Dorothy Gale and the Magic Belt. Later, when Dorothy and her companions fell into the underground realm during an earthquake, Ozma used her Magic Picture to locate them and brought them safely to the Emerald City.

label: Goals
value: Return safely home to Hugson's Ranch in California

label: Appearance
value: In his true form, he is a bald man.
unit: In his true form, he is a small, bald, elderly man with a wrinkled face. During his reign in the Emerald City, he used elaborate theatrical illusions, papier-mâché masks, and mechanical props to appear as a giant head, a lovely lady, a terrible beast, or a ball of fire to intimidate visitors.

label: Abilities
value: Leadership and quick strategic thinking

label: History
value: Santa Claus spends his time creating toys.
unit: Santa Claus resides in the Laughing Valley of Hohaho, where he spends his time creating toys with the aid of immortal beings for his annual Christmas deliveries. In The Road to Oz, he encounters Dorothy Gale, the Shaggy Man, Button-Bright, and Polychrome during their travels across the fairy realm. He travels alongside them to the Emerald City to attend Princess Ozma's grand birthday celebration. At the banquet, Santa Claus delights the guests with magical gifts and displays his jovial nature. Following the festivities, he travels back to his valley to prepare for his upcoming Christmas journey.
